accuracy_target.gate: Maximum pointwise errors and uncertainty intervals; RMSE below 5% alone does not pass
accuracy_target.reference_bias: Residual fine-reference DK bias remains uncertified

interpretation.allocation: Coverage and replication change together at a fixed total training-path budget
interpretation.conditional_intervals: Paired whole-trajectory resampling within each fixed anchor; conditional population generalization uncertainty is excluded
interpretation.covariance: Same-time 4x4 covariance only; no joint temporal covariance or density-path convergence claim
interpretation.ensemble_intervals: Paired whole initial-histogram and forcing families
interpretation.error_components: Neural errors use the training-step Euler law; total errors use fine DK or continuous OU references; signed components add but RMSEs do not
interpretation.optimizer_seeds: All reported individually; no best-seed selection or pooling as Monte Carlo samples
interpretation.paired_intervals: Pointwise 95% intervals; multiplicity unadjusted; negative differences favor the candidate
interpretation.reference_bias: Finite stopped-DK refinement contrasts do not certify residual continuous-time bias
interpretation.speedup: No matched-accuracy speed advantage is inferred
